# State of EOL forecast gallery

Open the pinned forecast for one of the 50 highest-ranked projects whose study scan read a supported dependency manifest. The browser fills in the repository and exact commit. Select **Fetch public files and run forecast** to review observed dates using the browser's current signed lifecycle data.
